settings.title: Settings
settings.generalIntro: Defaults that apply when you start the app without a full invitation link. Pairing QR codes still carry their own connection details.
settings.signalingHelp: Advanced: default WebSocket for discovery. Invites from QR always use the server embedded in the invite.
settings.childIntro1: These values apply on this device when it runs as the baby device. They are stored locally and picked up when monitoring starts.
settings.childIntro2: From a connected parent, use "Open settings on baby device" to jump this device here (same trust as listen controls).
settings.parentIntro: Listen, snooze, link quality, and notifications are on the parent device screen during a session.
settings.notificationsIntro: How alerts sound on this parent device. Run a probe test after pairing when both devices are connected.
settings.wakeLockListenLabel: Keep screen on in listen mode
settings.batteryIntro: Exempt GuardedSleep from aggressive battery optimization so monitoring can continue in the background.
settings.batteryWebHint: Battery exemption is configured in the Android system settings of the device.
settings.aboutIntro: GuardedSleep is a software baby monitor — it cannot alert if your parent device is off or out of battery.
settings.advancedWarning: Advanced settings can break monitoring if changed without care. Defaults work for most homes and events.
settings.diagnosticsPlaceholder: Diagnostics export and security fingerprint — coming in a later release.

listenButton.hint: Hold to listen, slide up to lock

onboarding.title: Welcome to GuardedSleep
onboarding.welcomeLead: A few quick steps so you know when monitoring is active — and when it is not.
onboarding.failureModelBody: Like every baby monitor, GuardedSleep cannot alert if your parent device dies. Keep it plugged in or charged when monitoring.
onboarding.trainingIntro: Watch the bar switch between connected and not monitoring. When the green indicator is gone, you are not receiving updates.
onboarding.trainingConnectedCopy: Connected — you are monitoring this room.
onboarding.trainingDisconnectedCopy: Not monitoring — you would not get noise alerts right now.
onboarding.batteryBody: On Android, allow GuardedSleep to run in the background and disable battery restrictions for reliable monitoring.
onboarding.batteryOpenFailed: Could not open battery settings. Try again or open them manually in Android system settings.
onboarding.doneLead: You are ready to pair the baby and parent devices.
onboarding.probeHint: After pairing, tap Test alert on the parent screen before you leave earshot.
